items.title: Fenerbahçe, Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde Aston Villa deplasmanında 6-0 yenildi
items.prompt: A classic black-and-white football with plain unmarked panels resting on wet grass on the white touchline of a floodlit pitch at night, shot low and close, the background dissolved into soft dark bokeh with glowing floodlight orbs and a hint of yellow and navy blue color. Color editorial sports photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens at f/2, natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic colors, fine detail, subtle film grain, calm atmospheric mood.
